description: Jonathan Hanto, Alena Diesing and Konstantin Löffler publish data for a study of cost and social acceptance in Germany’s energy transition. The original title specifies multi-objective optimisation. Zenodo exposes one XLSX file whose name identifies a Justice Factor, but the native description is empty. The resource is therefore catalogued only as the study’s energy-system optimisation data, without inferring an indicator definition or calculation method from the filename. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Germany; scenario years, regional subdivisions, units, sample sizes and parameter construction are unknown. The related GENeSYS-MOD record provides model-family context from this collection. This is not evidence of a validated public-acceptance measure or observed societal preferences. No spreadsheet values or article body were read.
